correctness.rationale: The standard empty-tetrahedron coefficient identities force \(h^*\)=1+(m-1)z². Multiplication by a lattice interval gives (kn+1)L(n), and generating differentiation yields the stated cubic. Its discriminant factors exactly as 4(m-1)(2k-m)[(m-1)(2k+1)^3-(4k-1)^3]. The transition-order identity, strict monotonicity, rational-cube boundary exclusion and direct repeated-root factorization prove the complete integer classification. Exact symbolic and lattice-count checks passed from the packaged checker; finite tests are not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural-family, all-parameter root classification for products of empty lattice tetrahedra with integer line segments, motivated by 2026 work on Cartesian-product preservation and real-rootedness. The exact transient versus permanent transition at normalized volume nine is a structural effect; Reeve realizations show arbitrarily large volumes with real-rooted \(h^*\) despite lattice width one and an initially non-real-rooted factor. The result determines precise heights and multiplicity boundaries, beyond a routine isolated computation.
